title: Deeper/broader peer capability, Unicode-route, and terminal-output audit
mode: primary-source web research and local read-only plan/source/test audit
scope: Refresh DWG/DXF peer capability claims against exact reader/writer directions
Reconcile current ACadSharp MTEXT/SPLINE reports with local route owners
Refine the existing source-DWG TV/TU to target-DXF text test matrix
Audit terminal EOF assertion strength in the existing DWG sample harness

method.kind: Read-only review of project capability sources, issue bodies, local source, tests, and plan
method.limitations: Peer issue reports are reporter-authored and are not local defect reproductions or normative format rules. ACadSharp #1299's linked drawing archive was not downloaded or inspected. The local writer comparison was source inspection only; no runtime or end-to-end CLI reproduction was performed.

sources.revision: mutable README and generated manual reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The repository advertises broad DWG read and conversion coverage while separately documenting advanced-object skips and version-specific writer limits. These claims apply to the named LibreDWG project/build, not libdxfrw.

sources.revision: current README/version matrix and open issue bodies reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The README separates DXF and DWG reader/writer columns. #1297 reports an AC1032 whole-file AutoCAD rejection for a frame-only MTEXT flag despite reportedly matching entity bytes; #1299 reports a v3.8.0 DWG-to-DXF-to-GDAL SPLINE failure but gives no structured offending arrays or independently measured expected curve in the issue body.

sources.project: LibreDWG issue #1414, Autodesk DXF string-storage reference, and RFC 3629
sources.revision: open issue and official string/UTF-8 references reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The peer report claims a source-DWG TV/TU route difference for escape-looking strings targeting the same modern DXF but does not settle field-specific escape interpretation. Autodesk documents target-version DXF string storage. RFC 3629 excludes UTF-8 encodings of surrogate code points.
The issue reports a peer conversion that may stop before ENTITIES or terminal EOF while reporting success. It does not establish an equivalent libdxfrw defect.

sources.project: Local libdxfrw output and regression paths
sources.observed: dxfRW::write emits EOF only after sections, checks stream/writer state and finalization, then publishes through DwgDxfOutputTransaction. tests/run_dwg_read_test.cmake currently checks EOF via substring presence, not a terminal group-0 EOF record. No located generated test/receipt demonstrates a paired DWG TV/TU source-storage to one target-DXF route across the planned field scopes.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-49/7F.1: assert a terminal group-0 EOF record in the existing sample CTest harness; preserve the larger partial-source/outcome test for the composed CLI gate
PAR-05/7AR: make the first source-storage characterization a generated TV/TU pair to one modern DXF target, with raw bytes, UTF-8 validity, and field-scoped semantic readback kept independent

implementationReadyChecks: Strengthen only the existing run_dwg_read_test.cmake structural check; keep its existing CTest registration and invocation count.
Use existing scratch DWG builders for TV/TU source controls and inspect ordinary text, MTEXT, and XRECORD separately.
Characterize literal backslash-U semantics before defining expected normalization; do not use LibreDWG output or global escape expansion as the oracle.
Keep lone-surrogate output invalid under strict UTF-8 admission and verify refusal without destination publication.
Retain the composed 7F.1 requirement for required-section completeness, source-loss disposition, truthful result status, and atomic strict output; terminal EOF alone does not prove those properties.
